method.served: Original no-cache server module, in-memory ROOT/PORT/ENTRY adjustment for relocated folder; loopback-only localhost:4189. Source files unchanged.

method.data: Local fictional prototype database on isolated origin; no backend calls, ledger writes, reset, save, submit, approve, reject or real messaging. Workstation/theme/text preferences only.
method.stateCoverage: Queue loading/empty/error simulated through UI; other state lists recorded as inventory, not full state verification.
method.limitations: No native device/full accessibility/financial-flow certification; three full-page capture requests are labelled; all screenshots can include prototype-only chrome.
